zh: 改善设置页的分组与控件：「配色」与「字体」改为开关；主窗口页把上下文图示、统计信息与计费归入新的「上下文与费用」组，「自定义计费表」排在「计费币种」下并在计费关闭时停用，「重绘权限控件」移到模型选择器之前；动效页按对话区、输入框、侧栏排序；「右侧栏卡片布局」排到侧栏页末尾；上下文两行改名为「上下文占用图示」与「上下文占用百分比」；「悬停展开弹层」「右侧栏卡片布局」与「进行中 / 已归档视图」补上说明。
en: Improve the settings page's grouping and controls: Colours and Typefaces become switches; the Main window tab gathers the context meter, the statistics and the billing into a new Context and cost group, with Custom price table under Billing currency and disabled while billing is off, and Redraw the permission control moves ahead of the model picker; the Motion tab runs chat area, composer, then sidebar; Right sidebar card layout closes the Sidebar tab; the two context rows become Context meter and Context percentage; and Open popovers on hover, Right sidebar card layout and Active / Archived view gain descriptions.
